text:
alex: Quick flag 3: runtime/api.md links to /guides/model-onboarding#steps but that slug was renamed to /guides/onboarding-models and the fragment is now #onboarding-steps. Users clicking the link hit a 404. Anyone own runtime/api.md?

tara: Can you paste the broken link so I can repro?

alex: Yep  From runtime/api.md: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/guides/model-onboarding#steps
Target should be: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/guides/onboarding-models#onboarding-steps

docs-bot: linkcheck: detected 404 on /guides/model-onboarding referenced from /runtime/api.md. First seen 2025-06-03.

devon: I can take a tiny PR to update the link. If we expect bookmarks, we should add a redirect stub at the old path.

jin: Docs-infra prefers a redirect markdown stub for moved guide slugs. Add frontmatter like: redirect_to: /guides/onboarding-models and a one-line explanation. Also add a smoke curl test in the docs smoke suite checking the original URL returns a 3xx then final contains onboarding-models.

alex: Plan: 1) change link in runtime/api.md to new path + fragment, 2) add redirect stub at guides/model-onboarding/index.md with frontmatter, 3) add curl smoke check to docs smoke tests. I'll open the PR today.

devon: Ping me for review, will keep it small.

jin: For local testing, run these commands before opening the PR:

```bash
# patch runtime file locally
sed -i "s@/guides/model-onboarding@/guides/onboarding-models@g" docs/runtime/api.md

# curl smoke check: expect 302/200 final URL contains onboarding-models
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}" "https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/guides/model-onboarding"
```

alex: I'll @docs-infra on the PR for frontmatter validation. Also adding a KB note about the slug rename so localization teams can backport if needed.

tara: Thanks 44D small fixes like this save a lot of support time. Also can you add a one-line test that verifies the fragment anchor resolves (curl with fragment is fine to check final URL)?

alex: Yep will add fragment check as well. Targeting a micro PR today, requesting reviewers devon and jin.

docs-bot: notice logged: docs.change (slug-migration) by alex. ID: dc-20250603-9

alex: PR opened: #3124-small-link-redirect-and-smoke. Assigning devon/jin for review, cc @docs-infra. Thanks!
